bookings_ota_block_shape.name: bookings_ota_block_shape
bookings_ota_block_shape.value: ("bookings"."source" = 'ota_ical') = ("bookings"."ota_connection_id" is not null and "bookings"."external_uid" is not null)

hotel_site_config_accent_color_check.name: hotel_site_config_accent_color_check
hotel_site_config_accent_color_check.value: "hotel_site_config"."accent_color" is null or (substr("hotel_site_config"."accent_color", 1, 1) = '#' and length("hotel_site_config"."accent_color") in (4, 7) and substr("hotel_site_config"."accent_color", 2) not glob '*[^A-Fa-f0-9]*')

ota_connections_single_target.name: ota_connections_single_target
ota_connections_single_target.value: not ("ota_connections"."room_id" is not null and "ota_connections"."room_type_id" is not null)

room_types_occupancy_values_check.name: room_types_occupancy_values_check
room_types_occupancy_values_check.value: "room_types"."base_occupancy" >= 1 and "room_types"."max_occupancy" >= "room_types"."base_occupancy" and json_valid("room_types"."occupancy_pricing") = 1 and json_type("room_types"."occupancy_pricing") = 'object' and "room_types"."child_rule" in ('age', 'height') and ("room_types"."child_rule_limit" is null or cast("room_types"."child_rule_limit" as numeric) >= 0)
